title: Share/sync with partner?
body: I love how clean and simple the app is, including the widgets. I would like to request a functionality: sharing counts with your partners. We have some common habits that we want to stop. I think as a developer you can use iCloud to share this easily without having your own sync server. Have a look at the app Magnets - shared widgets: it reminds me of your app (cleanliness and simple ness) and added sharing options via iCloud! Let me know if you need any input or beta testing from me! Keep doing what you do!
